# mighty.plumber

Utilities to setup a [plumber](https://www.rplumber.io) API serving
components for the
[mighty](https://novonordisk-opensource.github.io/mighty/) framework.

## Installation

``` r

# Install the development version from GitHub:
pak::pak("NovoNordisk-OpenSource/mighty.plumber")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`download_components()`](https://novonordisk-opensource.github.io/mighty.plumber/reference/download_components.md)
  : Download all mighty components from a repo location
